property_summary: For any callee address and amount, calling sendMoney on the correct contract never reverts even if the callee reverts (the reference ignores the low-level call return), whereas the mutated version will revert when the callee reverts; thus the reference always allows the call to complete and the mutant can fail for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace low-level call with a call that checks the return value and reverts on failure, changing whether sendMoney can silently fail.
